regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of a week ago. I certainly do remember you and your folks. How fortunate you have been in the faith God has given us strengthening it so often by super- natural responses to prayer -- as in the case of your dear Father Earl -- with his "hopeless" cancer! Glad to know he is well as also your little Sister Dorothy -- now V. Sister Mary Celia -- also wrote me. I have told hundreds of your Father's case when they brought him first time to St. Bonaventure's January 10, 1925, and how he surprised us when eight days later he brought your good Mother with him driving his own car -- looking 25 years younger !.
